title: Crumb and Punishment (Part 2)
description: The Maplewood bake-sale cartel goes to war with the Riverdale Boosters across the river, and Mildred has Darnell wearing a wire of fondant. Then Phil calls in. Phil, who supposedly left town. Phil runs Riverdale now, and the fall carnival has a Ferris wheel that owes nobody.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome back to Snazzie FM. When we left off, treasurer Mildred of the Maplewood PTA was, and I quote, sending the brownie man across the river. Mildred, you're still on the line.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Still on the line, sugar. <p:0.3> Darnell's in my minivan as we speak. He's wearing a wire. <p:0.3> It's a fondant wire, but it'll hold a recording.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: It's frosting, Ronnie. She frosted a microphone to my chest. I can feel it setting.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, she's running an operation. She has put a man undercover into a rival school's carnival.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's an exchange program, Barry. Schools love an exchange program.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: The Riverdale Boosters think the river's a border, sugar. It is not a border. The river is mine too. <p:0.3> I tax the ducks.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Oh, hi again, Mildred! I went to the Riverdale carnival once, the funnel cake was just divine. Don't tell anyone I said that.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Linda. Sweetheart. <p:0.3> We're gonna pretend you didn't just praise a competitor's funnel cake on the radio.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Okay, I'm at the gate. There's a guy here running the whole thing and he sounds really familiar and I don't... <p:0.3> oh no.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Evening, everybody. <p:0.3> It's Phil.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Phil? The Phil who got a visit? The flowers Phil?

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: I didn't leave town, Barry. I crossed the river. <p:0.3> And over here, Mildred, they made me president. Riverdale runs the whole east bank now. We don't pay the muffin tax.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Phil. Sugar. <p:0.3> You sold cookies a quarter under list. And now you're a president?

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: I undercut you because I had vision, Mildred. The carnival opens Saturday. Same day as your bake sale. <p:0.3> Funnel cake's a dollar.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now see, that's healthy competition. That's what makes the community strong.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: A dollar. <p:0.3> Darnell, sugar. The Ferris wheel. You see the bolts on the Ferris wheel?

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I am not touching the Ferris wheel, Mildred! I have my own family! I told you that last week!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, she just ordered a hit on a Ferris wheel. That is a felony and a fire hazard, Ronnie!

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: You touch my Ferris wheel, Mildred, and the ducks find out who really feeds them. <p:0.3> I've got a bread guy. I've got my own bread guy now.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: You turned my ducks?

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Oh, are we feeding the ducks? I love the ducks!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Linda, the ducks are a faction now! Everything is a faction! Run!

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Funnel cake's a dollar! Bring the kids, Mildred!

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Nobody undercuts the lemon bar, sugar!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Call the F B I! Call the river police!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Allegedly!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Alright, alright, beautiful energy. Two schools, one Saturday. We'll see you all out there for the kids. <p:0.3> That's our show.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Before you sign off, sugar. <p:0.3> Phil. <p:0.3> You said you had a bread guy.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: ...I have a bread guy.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: I'd hate for the bread guy to decide he bakes at Maplewood now. <p:0.3> Send Darnell back with a loaf. We'll talk.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: ...I never said I'd carry the loaf.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's a war, Ronnie. There's gonna be a turf war at a children's carnival.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's a bake sale, Barry.
